resources.string: Videos and photos taken in this app appear here automatically. You do not need to find their folders.
No SER/PSER videos yet. Choose SER or PSER in the camera recording settings, then record your target. MP4 videos cannot be used for planetary stacking.
Saved stacking results appear here: PNG for viewing and linear FITS for further processing. Save a result from live or planetary stacking to get started.
Photos taken in this app and saved stacking PNG images appear here.
FITS captures, recording sequences and linear stacking results appear here.
Videos recorded with the MP4 format appear here.
This file is no longer available. Choose another file below.
No app can play this MP4 video. Install a video player, then try again. Planetary stacking requires SER or PSER.
The video could not be opened. Check that the file is still available.
Save a full-resolution copy. FIT stores the processed values as Float32; color images use RGB planes.
There is insufficient memory to process this image at full resolution. Close other processing tasks and retry.
There is insufficient space to save the image. Free storage and retry.
The source image has changed or is unavailable. Reopen it before editing.
The current adjustments have not been saved. Save a copy to keep them.
Saving will stop and incomplete output will be removed.
LP700 converts color from a 700 nm infrared long-pass capture. It is optional. Saving bakes this conversion and the selected white balance and curve into the new image.
The edited image could not be saved.
